extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet is a family datasheet covering BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S; the BZT52C15S row was transcribed from page 2.

For BZT52C15S, the page 2 table gives VZ = 13.8 V minimum, 15.0 V nominal, and 15.6 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT = 30 ohm at IZT; ZZK = 200 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; IR maximum = 0.1 uA at VR = 10.5 V; and admissible zener current IZM = 5 mA.
The page 1 maximum-ratings table gives forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA and TA = 25 degC, with power dissipation PD = 200 mW.
The page 2 temperature-coefficient range for BZT52C15S is 9.2 to 13.0 mV/degC at IZT, TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or discrete junction-capacitance table value is provided for BZT52C15S; those fields are null.

Curve points were digitized from the family plots on page 3. The zener characteristic plot is a typical pulsed family plot, and the temperature-coefficient plot is a typical series-level curve rather than a device-specific table limit.
